text: Two hundred and twenty rejections. Most of them were sent by a robot.
A year ago, I had a good salary as an influencer marketing manager.
I quit, moved to Germany for my master's, and now it's forty thousand euros of debt.
So I did what you're told to do. I applied. Again, and again.
Two hundred and twenty times. Mostly automatic replies.
That's when it hit me. A robot was deciding if I get a job.
So I stopped applying, and hired the robots instead.
Now AI edits my videos, drafts my posts, and answers my comments. I built all of it.
Week two of fifty-two. The goal: three thousand euros a month, from anywhere.
So you decide. What do I sell first? A, AI content systems. Or B, influencer marketing consulting. Vote below.
